title: Plan
description: The JSON form Emacs emits from the plan Org file (design §1.1).

models.description: #+TT_MODELS: an optional provider/model per role and per seat. A role or seat absent from the object keeps Pi's defaultModel.

workerLanes.description: Plan 06g2: per-lane worker models (worker.1, worker.2); a lane without one uses worker's.

reviewerSeats.description: Per-seat reviewer models (reviewer.M, reviewer.A, reviewer.B); a seat without one uses reviewer's.

panelSeats.description: Per-seat panel models (panel.1, panel.2, panel.3); a seat without one uses the reviewer of its position when panelFrom is reviewers, else panel's.

panelFrom.description: `panel=reviewers`: each panel seat follows the reviewer model of its position.

consolidator.description: tt 09 (change 3): the consolidator that combines the lanes. Absent: the leader seat's reviewer model.

modelsLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_MODELS in the source Org file.

modelsRepeated.description: Lint-only: roles #+TT_MODELS named more than once (a JSON object cannot carry a duplicate key).

modelsFromProgram.description: A program entry only: roles its plan inherited from the program's #+TT_MODELS, already linted once at the program level.

rerun.description: #+TT_RERUN: the single-test command newly failing tests are re-run with, using the {name} and {file} placeholders. Absent: the built-in Node/cargo defaults, or the strict rule.

rerunLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_RERUN in the source Org file.

workers.description: Plan 06g/06h: #+TT_WORKERS — how many lanes one round runs, any positive whole number. Absent is today's single-candidate loop. A value that is not a whole number is passed through as written so `tt lint` can name it.

workersLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_WORKERS in the source Org file.

rounds.description: Plan 06g: #+TT_ROUNDS — how many rounds a phase may spend before it parks on the owner (1 to 5). Absent means the default of 3. A value that is not a whole number is passed through as written so `tt lint` can name it.

roundsLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_ROUNDS in the source Org file.

seats.description: Plan 06h: #+TT_REVIEWERS — the odd list of reviewer seats. Absent means M A B.

seatsLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_REVIEWERS in the source Org file.

leader.description: Plan 06h: #+TT_LEADER — the leader seat. Absent means the first seat.

leaderLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_LEADER in the source Org file.

consolidate.description: tt 09 (change 3): #+TT_CONSOLIDATE — on (the default with two or more workers) or off. Kept as written so `tt lint` can name a bad value.

consolidateLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_CONSOLIDATE in the source Org file.

domains.description: Plan 07a (D1): #+TT_DOMAINS — the plan's declared domains (name=glob[,glob…]), in declaration order. Absent means domain mode is off.

domainsLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_DOMAINS in the source Org file.

fixRounds.description: Plan 07c (D4): #+TT_FIX_ROUNDS — only `domains`, which switches fix rounds on. Absent means every round is today's. Kept as written so `tt lint` can name a bad value.

fixRoundsLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_FIX_ROUNDS in the source Org file.

fixers.description: Plan 07c (D4): #+TT_FIXERS — the most fixer tasks (one per domain) one fix round runs. Default 4. A value that is not a whole number is passed through as written so `tt lint` can name it.

fixersLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_FIXERS in the source Org file.

fixChecks.description: Plan 07c (D4): #+TT_FIX_CHECKS — the fast command every fixer's own commit must pass before it is merged.

fixChecksLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_FIX_CHECKS in the source Org file.

workerPrompt.description: #+TT_WORKER_PROMPT: per lane (a, b, ...), the absolute paths appended to that lane's worker system prompt (--append-system-prompt), in order. An empty list is `none`. A single worker uses lane a's.

workerPromptLine.description: Lint-only: the 1-based line of #+TT_WORKER_PROMPT in the source Org file.

workerPromptFromProgram.description: Lint-only: the lanes this entry inherited from the program's #+TT_WORKER_PROMPT.

line.description: The 1-based line of the phase headline, for a phase-override finding.

finalChecks.description: Plan 06c: the phase's final check (`#+TT_FINAL_CHECKS`, overridden by the phase's `:FINAL_CHECKS:`). Only the candidate about to be accepted runs it, once.

workers.description: Plan 06g: the phase's own :WORKERS: (overrides #+TT_WORKERS) — how many lanes one round runs.

rounds.description: Plan 06g: the phase's own :ROUNDS: (overrides #+TT_ROUNDS) — how many rounds the phase may spend.

seats.description: Plan 06h: the phase's own :REVIEWERS: (overrides #+TT_REVIEWERS) — the odd list of reviewer seats.

consolidate.description: tt 09 (change 3): the phase's own :CONSOLIDATE: (overrides #+TT_CONSOLIDATE) — on or off.

domains.description: Plan 07a (D1): the plan's declared domains (#+TT_DOMAINS), carried onto every phase. Absent means domain mode is off.

fixRounds.description: Plan 07c (D4): #+TT_FIX_ROUNDS, carried onto every phase. Absent means every round is today's.

fixers.description: Plan 07c (D4): #+TT_FIXERS, carried onto every phase. Absent means the default of 4.

ArchitectureItem.description: One architecture item (an :ID: subheading under Architecture).

RequirementItem.description: One requirement item (an :ID: subheading under Requirements).

ConstraintItem.description: One constraint item (an :ID: subheading under Constraints).

Domain.description: Plan 07a (D1): one declared domain — a name and the repository-relative globs it owns.

RoleModel.description: The provider and model a role runs with. Model ids may contain '/'.
